identity.definition: A family of structural proteins. In skin, collagen is an important part of the dermal extracellular matrix; topical and oral products may contain different collagen-derived materials.
identity.source_type: Protein or peptide material; source, collagen type, hydrolysis and molecular profile are product-specific.

preferred: Use the exact ingredient-list or supplement-facts wording photographed on the product
label_terms.rule: Treat these as possible market or label terms, not automatic synonyms. Never infer source, collagen type, hydrolysis, molecular mass, dose or route from the front claim alone.

identity_boundaries: Structural collagen in the dermis is not the same visual or biological state as collagen named in a topical formula.
An oral collagen or collagen-peptide product does not travel intact to facial skin as a direct delivery route.
Evidence for one hydrolyzed collagen preparation, dose and duration does not prove every powder, gummy, drink or topical product.
The ingredient actor is illustrative and must not be presented as microscopy or a specific collagen type.

visual_system.actor: A dimensional triple-ribbon fibre inside a translucent dermal-architecture lens.
visual_system.tactile_signature: Layered fibre ribbons, chalky skin strata, controlled translucency and a restrained architectural cutaway.
motion_grammar: Keep the three ribbons recognizable as one actor until a governed transformation explicitly fragments them.
Use route and depth changes as the main explanatory movement; avoid decorative helix rotation.
Damage is shown by structural discontinuity, protection by a boundary, and evidence by a separate dossier register.
Let the actor become quiet when the evidence or action hierarchy is primary.

components.purpose: Provide a persistent collagen recognition cue without claiming source, route, penetration or efficacy.
Separate the consumer term from exact label language, form and evidence boundaries.

components.type: editable SVG identity and route boundary map
components.purpose: Keep structural, topical, oral and post-digestion material states visually distinct.

evidence_records.claim: Ultraviolet exposure can induce matrix metalloproteinase pathways that degrade collagen in human skin.
evidence_records.scope: Mechanistic human-skin evidence about photoaging and collagen degradation.
limits: mechanism evidence, not a sunscreen-product comparison
does not quantify how much collagen an individual loses

citation.title: Molecular mechanisms of photoaging and its prevention by retinoic acid

evidence_records.claim: The 500 Dalton rule describes the observation that compounds larger than about 500 Da generally do not penetrate intact skin deeply enough for transdermal delivery.
evidence_records.scope: General skin-penetration rule used to explain a molecular-size boundary.
limits: general rule, not a test of every collagen formula
delivery systems and damaged skin require separate evidence
the component must state that its relative-size drawing is not to scale

citation.title: The 500 Dalton rule for the skin penetration of chemical compounds and drugs

evidence_records.claim: A 2023 meta-analysis of 26 randomized controlled trials with 1721 participants reported improvements in hydration and elasticity with hydrolyzed collagen supplementation, while also identifying biases and calling for larger trials.
evidence_records.scope: 26 RCTs; 1721 participants; pooled skin hydration and elasticity outcomes.
limits: heterogeneous preparations, sources, doses and durations
does not prove direct delivery to facial skin

citation.title: Effects of Oral Collagen for Skin Anti-Aging: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

evidence_records.claim: A 2025 meta-analysis of 23 randomized controlled trials with 1474 participants found pooled improvements, but no significant effect across hydration, elasticity and wrinkles in non-industry-funded studies; high-quality studies also showed no significant effect in the reported categories.
evidence_records.scope: 23 RCTs; 1474 participants; subgroup analyses by funding source and study quality.
limits: subgroup membership counts are not supplied for an illustrative tile layout
do not display a survivor count
ingredient preparations and trial designs differ

citation.title: Effects of Collagen Supplements on Skin Aging: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

evidence_records.claim: One randomized, double-blind, vehicle-controlled study found that topical 0.4% retinol improved fine wrinkling on naturally aged arm skin and increased procollagen I immunostaining in a small biopsy subgroup.
evidence_records.scope: 36 elderly participants; left-right arm comparison; up to three applications weekly for 24 weeks.
limits: does not establish suitability for every viewer

citation.title: Improvement of naturally aged skin with vitamin A (retinol)

safe_default: Collagen is an important structural protein in the skin's dermal matrix.
A collagen ingredient named in a cream is not the same thing as replacing dermal collagen.
Oral collagen products are digested and absorbed as smaller components rather than delivered intact to the face.
Evidence must stay attached to the tested preparation, route, dose, duration and population.
requires_context: Too large to penetrate — state the intact-skin boundary and the general nature of the 500 Dalton rule.
Improves hydration, elasticity or wrinkles — name the review, route, trial count and limitations.
No evidence — distinguish no significant effect in selected subgroups from proof of no possible effect.
Retinoids support collagen production — state the tested topical material, population, body site and suitability qualifier.

story_slots.purpose: Establish collagen as the story subject while separating forms and routes.
avoid: one generic helix representing every collagen-derived material

story_slots.purpose: Explain the intact-skin boundary and distinguish a surface film from structural replacement.
avoid: penetration verdict without route and formula context

story_slots.purpose: Show digestion and non-preferential body distribution without a direct facial-delivery claim.
avoid: highlighting facial skin as the guaranteed destination

story_slots.purpose: Show reported pooled outcomes and what changes after funding and quality filters.
Prioritize protection and evidence-backed options while keeping collagen formats optional.
avoid: letting optional collagen products visually outrank protective actions

format_input.boundary_card: Form and route first: topical surface behavior, oral digestion and dermal structure are not interchangeable states.

legacy_quarantine.reason: Useful state and continuity source, but the flat three-wave drawing is not the approved V2 visual actor.
Story-specific metaphor; do not promote as a reusable ingredient component.
